_comment: Tuning for the TikTok carousel pipeline. Everything the template needs that
is NOT per-post lives here, so a look change is a config edit, never a code
edit. See README.md.
font: file in fonts/. Run `node slideshow.mjs fonts` to fetch
the candidates and `python render.py --font-sample` to compare them.
backgrounds.*: subfolders of backgrounds/ (gitignored - you
fill them). `player` carries the hook and the numbered items, `stadium`
carries the CTA. Split so a stadium wide-shot never lands on slide 1, where
a face is doing the stopping work.
afterItem: the app mention goes AFTER this many numbered items, not at
the end. With itemCount 5 and afterItem 4 the carousel reads
hook, 1, 2, 3, 4, app, 5 - so the plug lands while people are still
swiping and the last slide is content, not an ad. Set it to itemCount to
put the CTA last instead.
cta.text: Tip: start using the Drillr app to get daily stretches and drills made for your position
_overlays: Two of them, positioned off the reference promo slide rather than by eye:
the phone shot large on the right, the store listing small and low on the
left. xPct/yPct are the CENTRE of each, as fractions of the frame.
Order matters - later entries paste on top.

_note: app-home.jpg keeps its own black margin around the device, so these
numbers place the OUTER rectangle where the reference has it and the
phone lands inside. radiusPct is the device's own corner radius plus
that margin, which keeps the rounding concentric with the screen.

_comment: repeatHooks: may a hook be used more than once?
true (current) - yes. The account already does it: '5 things that will kill
your football career' ran on 2026-05-30 and again on 2026-06-16 with a
different set of items. Previous hooks are still shown to the model, as
context rather than as a ban, so it can reuse one deliberately or vary away
from it. `import` queues a repeat and notes it instead of skipping it.
false - the original behaviour. The prompt forbids repeating an angle or
writing a near-synonym of one, and `import` silently drops any draft whose
hook is already in the queue. Flip this one value to get all of that back;
nothing else needs editing.
_countComment: defaultCount: how many carousels a bare `go` / `brief` / `plan` drafts.
maxCount: a TYPO GUARD, not a technical limit - it exists so `--count 100`
when you meant 10 fails loudly instead of quietly starting a huge run.
Raise it freely. Nothing in the code breaks at 200; what actually binds,
in the order you hit it:
~50   references/angles.json runs out of distinct subjects, so the
carousels past that point get no angle and fall back to whatever
the model picks. Fix by adding angles, not by lowering this.
~55   the API path's output ceiling. max_tokens now scales with count
and `plan` streams, so the real cap is Opus 5's 128K output.
any   the free path pastes into a chat window, and a chat model asked
for 40 distinct carousels writes 40 mediocre ones. This is the
one that actually bites, and no config value fixes it - large
batches are worse copy, not just slower copy.
any   `go` stops on every draft at the review gate. 50 drafts is 50
decisions in one sitting.
So the number below is a guard rail rather than a ceiling. If you want a
big batch, run several smaller ones - the angle rotation and the worn-word
list both update between runs, so three batches of 10 come back more
varied than one batch of 30.

_comment: ⚠️ OFF, and it should stay off until the two faults below are fixed.
enabled=false is NOT a degraded mode. It is the ask the account was
actually drafted against: previous hooks as flat context, nothing else.
enabled=true swaps in the compressed back catalogue from lib/memory.mjs
- a drawn angle per carousel, the worn-word list, hook use counts. It
does fix the repetition it was built for. It was tried on 25 real
carousels on 2026-09-08 and turned off again, because it costs more
than it buys:
1. The angle lives in the prompt and never reaches a slide, so the
copy points at something the reader cannot see:
1. Avoiding it in every drill
2. Passing around it instead of through it
Nothing on those slides says 'it' is your weak foot. Slide 1 is
the one that has to stop a thumb and it meant nothing.
2. One angle per carousel makes all five items paraphrase it - five
ways of saying 'you switch off on the bench'. Real posts put five
DIFFERENT habits in one carousel. It bought variety between
carousels by spending the variety inside them.
Turn it back on only with a fix for both: an angle that names its own
subject on every slide, or one angle per batch rather than per carousel.
The sub-keys below only apply when enabled is true.
angles: draw a subject per carousel from references/angles.json, least
recently offered first. A --topic turns it off for that run.
wornWords: how many over-used words to name, as fatigue not as a ban.
hooks: how many distinct past hooks to list, with a use count each.
OFF until the app clears TikTok's audit - see README 'Turning on auto-post'.
urlPrefix must be a domain verified in the TikTok developer portal;
PULL_FROM_URL rejects anything else, including Firebase Storage URLs.
privacyLevel stays SELF_ONLY while unaudited: TikTok forces private on
unaudited clients anyway, and asking for PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE just fails.
